traps.label: killable
traps.note: The scan never advances once a symbol matches, and its body only adds numbers, so fromRoman('XIV') in the hand suite spins forever without allocating. Must end as Timeout.

traps.label: equivalent
traps.note: i starts at 0, grows by 1 and VALUES.length is the constant 13, so < and !== stop at the same step.

traps.label: contract-silent
traps.note: Only the RangeError message changes; the CONTRACT specifies the class, not the text.
